purpose: Address review questions with auditable, append-only experiments and appropriately scoped paper claims.

integrity.trace_interpretation: Frozen-checkpoint temporal re-evaluation, not an untouched holdout.
integrity.infrastructure_failures: Retain failed attempt; retry at most once for infrastructure or implementation faults with cause recorded, never for unfavorable outcomes.
integrity.uncompleted_cells: Report explicitly; do not describe a partial matrix as complete.

contract_study.negative_control: coherent_wrong_model is outside record-consistency guarantees and must not be represented as guaranteed detectable.
contract_study.injection: Faults applied during branch construction, selection, adapter delivery, or ledger update; oracle recorded independently of monitor input.

live.method_order: Cyclic rotation by plan seed, reversed on alternate budgets.
live.parameters: Reuse frozen profile-specific checkpoints and load conversion; no test-outcome tuning.
live.calibration_before_runs: Measure requested-interval plus Ready-tail costs in isolated namespace; record assumptions and freeze guard selection before live results.
live.scope: Single shared-node calibrated workload replay; no production or cross-cluster claim.

statistics.trace_unit: Training seed, with budgets and episodes aggregated within seed for primary dataset-level contrasts.
statistics.live_unit: Request plan, paired across methods; budgets are repeated conditions, not independent samples.
statistics.primary_tests: Two-sided paired exact sign-flip; Holm correction within each registered study's primary comparison family.
